moments.title: Every asset has its own personality — cash, debt, real estate, gold and equity as five friends
moments.summary: A One Minute Investing School lesson that gives each asset class a character: cash the cautious friend, debt the predictable one, real estate the slow and steady one, gold the crisis friend, equity the ambitious and dramatic one.
moments.evidence: Not every asset is the same. In fact, every asset has its own personality.

moments.title: No asset class is "the best" — that is what asset allocation is
moments.summary: The payoff of the lesson: no personality is best because different situations need different friends, and that is the foundation of asset allocation.
moments.evidence: No personality is the best because different situations need different friends. And that's the foundation of something called asset allocation.
